name: Nakadashi AV Satsuei ~Shakkin Tsuma Haramase Onsen Ryokou Anata no Tsuma ga AV Shutsuen Shimasu~
original_name: 膣内射精AV撮影 ～借金妻 孕ませ温泉旅行 あなたの妻がAV出演します～
source:
It's only a few more days till the third anniversary of Soichi's and Yurina's marriage.
They are happy but their love life is lacking because of Soichi's low sex drive.

To improve their situation Soichi occassionally rents adult videos.
One day he comes by a film where the actress kinda looks like Yurina. But there is no way his loving, timid wife would do something like that.
